Your laps

Things you can build

A portal to a whole new district
Build a frame out of obsidian, fill the middle in with any block, then light it with Flint & Steel. Whatever you fill it with decides where it goes — snow takes you somewhere snowy, sand somewhere sandy.
Furniture for a house
Tap the block button, then For a house. A bed takes two blocks and puts its headboard against the wall; a door takes two, one above the other. Press BUILD on a door to open it, or on a chair to turn it round. Plates and cake go on top of a table. When the 🪑 button appears you can sit down — on a chair, a toilet or in the bath.
A zoo, with animals in it
Tap the block button, then For a zoo. Build a ring of fence to make a pen — one block high is enough, because no animal will walk over a fence even though you can jump it. Put a gate in the ring and press BUILD on it to swing it open and shut. Then walk up to a pig, a sheep, a cow or a crab: when the 🫳 button appears you can pick it up, carry it to the pen and put it down inside.
A shop, with a till that pays
Tap the block button, then For a shop. Build shelves and put food on top of them — bread, apples, milk, and the cake and cups from For a house all work. Stand at a shelf and the 🛒 button appears: press it to put that thing in your basket. Then stand at the register and press 🧾 to ring it all up — it beeps once for every thing and pays you the total. Every ⭐ you find is worth 5 coins too, and nothing in the game can take them off you.
